title: Anticancer Peptides: Design Principles, Translational Bottlenecks, and Emerging Opportunities.
snippet: Anticancer peptides (ACPs) are frequently discussed as a single therapeutic class, yet the term encompasses molecules that perform markedly different jobs: direct tumor-cell killing, intracellular target modulation, tumor homing and penetration, or selective delivery of a separate payload.
